title: A shared playbook for trustworthy third party evaluations
summary: OpenAI shares guidance on third-party AI evaluations, covering how to assess model capabilities, safeguards, and validity for frontier systems.
body: OpenAI shares guidance on third-party AI evaluations, covering how to assess model capabilities, safeguards, and validity for frontier systems.
summaryZh: OpenAI发布了一份关于可信第三方AI评估的共享游戏规则与指南，系统涵盖了如何对前沿人工智能系统进行独立、客观的能力考量、安全边界审查以及有效性验证，对推动行业标准化评测具有积极参考价值。原始信息显示：OpenAI shares guidance on third-party AI evaluations, covering how to assess model capabilities, safeguards, and validity for frontier systems.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“A shared playbook for trustworthy third party evaluations”。其重要性主要体现在：OpenAI分享了关于第三方大模型评估的指导方针，规范了前沿系统能力与安全性的测试标准。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
